The Meltdown Room • Rant Room

Interactive Burn Release

Bring what weighs on your heart to the fire. You are in control.

How It Works

  1. Write or paste your thoughts.
  2. Choose whether to keep a private copy.
  3. Tap Start Burning.
  4. Drag the flame across the paper.
  5. Watch it curl, burn, and turn to ash.

Nothing is deleted unless you choose to burn it.

Great Room  ›  Burn Release

Your words are still safe. Start only when you are ready.
